summary: You present a relevant Australian reef-monitoring concept, explain why one spacecraft is proposed, and use STK screenshots and access analysis to develop the design. To strengthen the report, substantiate the imaging and communications claims, verify the launch and end-of-life plans, and draw more evidence-based conclusions. Clearer figure presentation and complete, consistent references will also improve the report’s professionalism.
next_steps: In Orbit, define the spacecraft’s initial state with a reference epoch and complete orbital elements; clarify SSO illumination and quantify sensor swath, ground resolution and coverage for the reef-monitoring task.

In Launch, verify that the selected vehicle, interface, schedule and injection orbit are feasible. In Ground Control & Communications, support access and contact claims with the station geometry, elevation mask and analysis period; include the STK project files.

In Mission Duration & EOL, calculate drag-sail decay time and assess disposal against applicable limits. In Conclusion, use these results and limitations to reach specific findings; improve figure numbering and captions, and provide complete, consistent references.

criteria.C1: Your Introduction explains the reef-monitoring purpose, Australian relevance and rationale for one spacecraft, and identifies likely science and government users. To strengthen this, distinguish the spacecraft operator from customers and support the specific mission need and user roles with stronger references.
criteria.C2: Your Orbit and Ground Control & Communications sections use STK screenshots and access analysis to present a preliminary design. For the next level, demonstrate feasibility: verify the speculative Vega E choice, fully define the orbital state, quantify imaging performance and communications assumptions, provide STK files, and calculate whether the drag sail achieves safe disposal.
criteria.C3: Your Conclusion recaps the proposed launch, orbit and ground station. To reach the next level, draw specific conclusions from your analyses and address key uncertainties, including imaging capability, contact assumptions and end-of-life feasibility.
criteria.C4: Your report has a recognizable structure, executive summary, figures, tables and bibliography. For the next level, use consistent figure and table numbering and captions, edit grammatical errors, and provide complete, consistently formatted references that correspond to in-text citations.
